lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਾਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapai aap pachhaaniaa saad meethaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Those who recognize their own selves, enjoy the sweet flavor, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਚਾਖਿਐ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਸਾਚੋ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ras chaakhiai mukat bhae jinhaa saacho bhaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who drink in the sublime essence of the Lord are emancipated; they love the Truth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu niramal niramalaa niramal man vaasaa ||
lines.translation: The Beloved Lord is the purest of the pure; He comes to dwell in the pure mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee saalaaheeai bikhiaa maahi udaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Praising the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, one remains unaffected by corruption. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਸਭ ਅੰਧੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai aap na jaapaee sabh a(n)dhee bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, they do not understand themselves -they are totally blind, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee ghat chaananaa naam a(n)t sakhaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated, and in the end, only the Naam shall be your companion. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਰਤਦੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naame hee naam varatade naame varataaraa ||
lines.translation: They are occupied with the Naam, and only the Naam; they deal only in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar naam mukh naam hai naame sabad veechaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: Deep within their hearts is the Naam; upon their lips is the Naam; they contemplate the Word of God, and the Naam. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam suneeai naam ma(n)neeai naame vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: They listen to the Naam, believe in the Naam, and through the Naam, they obtain glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam salaahe sadaa sadaa naame mahal paaee ||4||
lines.translation: They praise the Naam, forever and ever, and through the Naam, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naame hee ghat chaananaa naame sobhaa paaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, their hearts are illumined, and through the Naam, they obtain honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naame hee sukh oopajai naame saranaaee ||5||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, peace wells up; I seek the Sanctuary of the Naam. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai koi na ma(n)neeai manamukh pat gavaaee ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, no one is accepted; the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: jam pur baadhe maareeahi birathaa janam gavaaee ||6||
lines.translation: In the City of Death, they are tied down and beaten, and they lose their lives in vain. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੈ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamai kee sabh sevaa karai guramukh naam bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who realize the Naam, all serve the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੁ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naamahu hee naam ma(n)neeai naame vadiaaee ||7||
lines.translation: So believe in the Naam, and only the Naam; through the Naam, glorious greatness is obtained. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no devai tis milai guramatee naam bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: He alone receives it, unto whom it is given. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh naavai kai vas hai poorai bhaag ko paaee ||8||7||29||
lines.translation: O Nanak, everything is under the influence of the Naam; by perfect good destiny, a few obtain it. ||8||7||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੑੀ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dohaaganee mahal na paainhee na jaanan pir kaa suaau ||
lines.translation: The deserted brides do not obtain the Mansion of their Husband's Presence, nor do they know His taste.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਾ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: phikaa bolahi naa nivahi doojaa bhaau suaau ||1||
lines.translation: They speak harsh words, and do not bow to Him; they are in love with another. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu manooaa kiu kar vas aavai ||
lines.translation: How can this mind come under control?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਠਾਕੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee thaakeeai giaan matee ghar aavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, it is held in check; instructed in spiritual wisdom, it returns to its home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਓਨੁ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee aap savaareeon laai prem piaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself adorns the happy soul-brides; they bear Him love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai chaladeeaa naame sahaj seegaar ||2||
lines.translation: They live in harmony with the Sweet Will of the True Guru, naturally adorned with the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa raavahi pir aapanaa sachee sej subhaai ||
lines.translation: They enjoy their Beloved forever, and their bed is decorated with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮੋਹੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: pir kai prem moheeaa mil preetam sukh paai ||3||
lines.translation: They are fascinated with the Love of their Husband Lord; meeting their Beloved, they obtain peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan apaar seegaar hai sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
lines.translation: Spiritual wisdom is the incomparable decoration of the happy soul-bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saa sabharaaee su(n)daree pir kai het piaar ||4||
lines.translation: She is so beautiful - she is the queen of all; she enjoys the love and affection of her Husband Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਅਲਖਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee vich ra(n)g rakhion sachai alakh apaar ||
lines.translation: The True Lord, the Unseen, the Infinite, has infused His Love among the happy soul-brides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa sachai bhaai piaar ||5||
lines.translation: They serve their True Guru, with true love and affection. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee seegaar banaaiaa gun kaa gal haar ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride has adorned herself with the necklace of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਵਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: prem piramal tan laavanaa a(n)tar ratan veechaar ||6||
lines.translation: She applies the perfume of love to her body, and within her mind is the jewel of reflective meditation. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਊਤਮਾ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat rate se ootamaa jat pat sabade hoi ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with devotional worship are the most exalted. Their social standing and honor come from the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai sabh neech jaat hai bisataa kaa keeRaa hoi ||7||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, all are low class, like maggots in manure. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਦੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਹਉ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karadee sabh phirai bin sabadai hau na jaai ||
lines.translation: Everyone proclaims, "Me, me!"; but without the Shabad, the ego does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੮॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate tin haumai gaee sachai rahe samaai ||8||8||30||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam lose their ego; they remain absorbed in the True Lord. ||8||8||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache rate se niramale sadaa sachee soi ||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the True Lord are spotless and pure; their reputation is forever true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਆਗੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aithai ghar ghar jaapade aagai jug jug paragat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: Here, they are known in each and every home, and hereafter, they are famous throughout the ages. ||1||
